title: Museum of Archaeology & Ethnology

services.name: Group Bookings And Tours
services.desc: The MAE is open for school groups of all ages to visit. Programming is available through the Department of Archaeology and can be requested using this form (please note this must be booked 6-8 weeks in advance). MAE staff can provide tours for all age groups. Self guided visits are also possible. Please contact the Museum with details to book a time and tour. The MAE is happy to facilitate educational visits for SFU classes from all departments. Staff can also provide a tour or talk as needed. Please contact the Museum with details to book a time.
